description: Read the Sealed Deal Board: sealed boxes and decks that third-party stores list, one row per product. Each row carries the store, productUrl, retailerPriceUsd, marketPrice (the product's TCGplayer market price, USD), anchorPriceUsd with anchorSource, tcgProductId, shippingPolicy and age stamps: firstSeenAt (the day the board first carried that product), firstSeenBasis, priceBeatenAt with priceBeatenFromUsd (the day its cheapest price fell at least 5% and at least $10 under its own trailing 30-day low), and recencyEventAt, the later of the two, so you can answer "what is new since <date>" without diffing the whole board. Filter by game and productType (for example booster_display); results come in pages of limit rows with nextCursor, which is null on the last page. A caller with no account, or without Investor access, gets the public preview the website shows: a few rows per currency with entitled false. A caller with Investor access gets the full board. Call spellbook_sealed_product_offers with a row's tcgProductId for every store's offer and the sold comparables. Rows arrive in the board's order. Compare retailerPriceUsd with marketPrice yourself; this returns facts and ranks nothing by recency or discount. Each TCGplayer product id carries tcgplayerBuyUrl, a short SpellBook Finance affiliate link to that TCGplayer page. Say it is an affiliate link when you share it.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page, passed back unchanged with the same game and productType. Omit to start from the first page.

game.description: Restrict rows to one game: mtg, riftbound or pokemon. Omit to include all games.

limit.description: Maximum deal rows per page, 1 to 50. Omit for the default of 15.

productType.description: Restrict rows to one sealed product type, for example booster_display for a booster box or collector_box. Omit to include every type.

name: spellbook_sealed_deal_board
